tools.wedding-vow-writer.p_text.zola_s_2: Zola's 2026 First Look Report found 63% of couples think AI has no place in writing vows. This tool never invents your stories — it only structures what you type.
tools.wedding-vow-writer.h2_text.why_vow: Why vows are now the centre of the ceremony
tools.wedding-vow-writer.span_text.the_k: The Knot's 2026 Real Weddings Study, based on 10,474 US couples married in 2025, found that
tools.wedding-vow-writer.strong_text.61_: 61% wrote their own vows — the highest rate ever recorded
tools.wedding-vow-writer.span_text.up_fr: , up from 44% in its 2019 study. As ceremonies move away from a fixed religious script, the vows carry more of the emotional weight. That also makes them harder to write: a vow has to sound like one specific person speaking to one specific person, in front of everyone they love.
tools.wedding-vow-writer.span_text.ranke: Ranked US guides from Zola, Joy and independent officiants converge on a
tools.wedding-vow-writer.span_text.targe: target, which takes roughly one to two minutes to say aloud. The structure below is the four-part version used by most of them.
tools.wedding-vow-writer.h2_text.the_fou: The four-part frame and its word budget
tools.wedding-vow-writer.td_text.say_the: Say their actual name and one line about who they are
tools.wedding-vow-writer.td_text.a_singl: A single concrete memory — a place, a detail, a moment you knew
tools.wedding-vow-writer.td_text.keepabl: Keepable actions, at least one you could prove next Tuesday
tools.wedding-vow-writer.td_text.one_sho: One short line about the life ahead, then stop
tools.wedding-vow-writer.p_text.the_prom: The promises are the part that separates a vow from a toast. A line with "I will" in it is a promise; a list of qualities is a speech. Officiants quoted in the top-ranking guides suggest three to six of them, and warn that vague ones are where guests switch off.
tools.wedding-vow-writer.p_text.the_word: The word counter above estimates speaking time at 150 words per minute (average US conversation pace) and at 100 wpm (a slow, nervous ceremony pace). Plan for the slower number: pauses, a breath, and a wobble or two will add time. Print the final draft on a card rather than reading it from a phone — several of the ranked guides call this out as the single most repeated practical tip.

tools.wedding-vow-writer.summary_text.ho: How long should wedding vows be?
tools.wedding-vow-writer.p_text.most_us_: Most US guides recommend 150–250 words, which takes about one to two minutes to read aloud. Read at a slower pace than feels natural — nerves speed you up, and a 200-word vow at 100 words per minute takes two minutes.
tools.wedding-vow-writer.summary_text.wh: What is the basic structure of personal wedding vows?
tools.wedding-vow-writer.p_text.four_par: Four parts: an opening that says your partner's name, one specific shared memory, three to six concrete promises, and a single closing line about the future. In a 200-word vow the story and promises take roughly 40% each.
tools.wedding-vow-writer.summary_text.ho: How many couples write their own vows?
tools.wedding-vow-writer.p_text.61_of_us: 61% of US couples wrote personal or personalised vows according to The Knot's 2026 Real Weddings Study of 10,474 couples — the highest rate recorded, up from 44% in 2019.
tools.wedding-vow-writer.summary_text.ca: Can I combine traditional vows with personal ones?
tools.wedding-vow-writer.p_text.often_ye: Often yes. A hybrid — a brief personal statement followed by the required traditional wording — is increasingly common and satisfies most liturgical requirements. Check with your officiant: Catholic ceremonies in particular restrict the approved formulations.
tools.wedding-vow-writer.summary_text.do: Does this tool use AI to write my vows?
tools.wedding-vow-writer.p_text.no_zola_: No. Zola's 2026 First Look Report found 63% of couples believe AI has no place in writing vows. This builder only arranges sentences you type into a proven four-part structure, counts the words, and estimates speaking time. Nothing leaves your browser.
tools.wedding-vow-writer.summary_text.sh: Should I read my vows from my phone?
tools.wedding-vow-writer.p_text.most_off: Most officiants and ranked guides recommend a printed card instead. A phone screen reads as a script, glares in outdoor light, and is easy to lose in the moment. Use the Print / PDF button and trim the page to card size.
tools.wedding-vow-writer.p_text.vows_are: Vows are the audio spine of a wedding film. Turn your photos and recordings into a 60–90 second cinematic keepsake.
